rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. The second counts the taxpayer's and the spouse's entries separately by role and tests the spouse only on a joint return; the project counts every person on the return against the roster. The roster has one entry for you and, only on a joint return, one for your spouse (household.roster_bad refuses any other at Form 1040 line 1a), so within scope the two agree (i1040gi p. 40, Step 1, question 2, 'Do you, and your spouse if filing a joint return, have a social security number ... that allows you to work and is valid for EIC purposes'; p. 44, 'For the EIC, a valid SSN is a number issued by the Social Security Administration unless "Not Valid for Employment" is printed on the social security card and the number was issued solely to allow the recipient of the SSN to apply for or receive a federally funded benefit').
